#TrafficUpdate
Due to heavy traffic flow during peak hours, vehicular movement is slow from SNT towards NFCL and from Panjagutta Flyover towards Begumpet Flyover.
Commuters are advised to plan their travel accordingly, use alternate routes if possible, and cooperate with traffic personnel on duty.
